title: Design System: Sana Ishaq — editorial portfolio
authority: User-approved Modern Editorial Minimalism, decision register and original homepage reference

extensions.source: src/styles/editorial.css (locked system); src/styles/homepage.css (scoped extensions); normative primitives in DESIGN.md frontmatter

shadows.purpose: Menu separation at 650px in Phase 1 and 1000px in complete candidate.
shadows.name: mobile-menu

motion.purpose: Hover moves link icons 2px right and 2px up; reduced motion removes transition and travel.
motion.name: link-icon-feedback
archive-preview-reveal
motion.purpose: Desktop hover/focus previews; removed with reduced motion.

themePreference.hydration: Real icon-only button disabled until ready; no-JS accessible name: Theme switching requires JavaScript
themePreference.fallback: CSS system preference; storage denial retains in-memory choice
themePreference.initialization: System preference initializes and tracks changes until an explicit light/dark choice; saved legacy system preference remains valid
themePreference.interaction: Click, touch or keyboard switches immediately between light and dark; choice persists after refresh; no System reset UI
themePreference.accessibleName: Switch to dark mode / Switch to light mode, reflecting the destination
themePreference.icon: 20px outline SVG; moon in First Light, sun in Juniper Dusk
themePreference.placement: One button outside Menu beside its summary; visible with Menu closed
themePreference.target: 48px square, 12px padding, square corners, transparent background, no border
themePreference.states: Link color at rest; ink on hover; shared 3px link-colored focus outline with 6px offset

extensions.mobileMenu: Native details; global Escape closes the menu and restores summary focus, including from the adjacent theme toggle; no-JS open panel stays in flow; 48px summary target with 4px 0 4px 8px padding and 12px header gap fits 320px
extensions.evidence: Owner confirms the published case-study Results section is the authoritative verified baseline. Four exact results retain labels and context; shared team attribution and one full reporting-context link follow the group. Missing analytics artifacts do not disprove published results. Proposed question remains visibly pending verification.

outcomeLayout.placement: Immediately after the original image field, before the proposed question
outcomeLayout.desktop: Actual-count columns; four equal columns with 48px gap; one column caps at 740px
outcomeLayout.narrowDesktop: At 1100px and below, four results use two equal columns with 40px row / 48px column gap; other multi-result layouts use 28px gap
outcomeLayout.mobile: At 650px and below, all counts use aligned rows with two equal value/text columns, 24px column gap and 36px row gap
outcomeLayout.numberTypography: Normative outcome-value and outcome-value-mobile roles in DESIGN.md frontmatter
outcomeLayout.attribution: One shared attribution with a single Published results and reporting context link; 32px top margin desktop, 36px mobile

heroLayout.headline: 1120px maximum width, balanced wrapping; display role in DESIGN.md; exact baseline copy unchanged
heroLayout.support: Below headline: 64px top margin; minmax(0,1fr) / minmax(0,.8fr) columns; clamp(64px,8vw,144px) column gap
heroLayout.actions: Right column, vertically grouped with 12px gap
heroLayout.narrowDesktop: At 1100px and below: 64px column gap and 16px paragraph
heroLayout.tablet: 651–850px: natural stack, 44px support top margin, 700px headline cap, 17px/1.75 paragraph, 28px CTA top margin
heroLayout.mobile: 650px and below: natural stack, 44px support top margin, 40ch paragraph at 16px/1.7, 36px CTA top margin and 8px action gap

archiveBackdrop.purpose: Native project-note dialog backdrop, not a palette primitive.

homepageLayout.compact: 1000px: Menu, stories/Process stack with 20% context/list indents; Contact stacks with 25% context indent; Archive previews hide.
homepageLayout.mobile: 650px: 96px editorial block spacing; Services/About stack; indents reset; Archive rows min 112px; two-column footer.
homepageLayout.pacing: Archive bottom 112px; Services top/bottom and About top 96px; About top 48px mobile.
homepageLayout.about: Text-led sourced biography, location, LinkedIn and published resume; no portrait.
homepageLayout.contact: Existing ink/canvas inverted; real call, role-discussion and email links; currentColor focus.

featuredArtwork.subscribeMe: Three original interfaces at -4/2/5 degrees; mobile browsing image only, unrotated, in 520px field.
featuredArtwork.utworx: Original overview at 88% width; full-width focused original crop on mobile.
featuredArtwork.authority: Original artwork derivatives; no generated imagery; HaierMall geometry unchanged.

archive.preview: Above 1000px: aria-hidden noninteractive original-artwork 4:3 preview, min(27vw,340px), right 64px/top 70%, alternating -6/5 degrees, 10px canvas surround, hover and focus-visible.
archive.routing: Real static anchors; unmodified desktop activation with native dialog support pushes note URL and opens modal. Compact/modified clicks, direct URLs, reload, no-JS and unsupported dialogs use static pages.
archive.focus: aria-labelledby; Close initially focused; native modality and explicit Tab wrapping; closing restores origin focus, scroll and overflow.
archive.history: Close/Escape/backdrop request Back; popstate closes/restores or reopens on Forward; open dialog survives resize.
archive.fallback: aria-haspopup only when desktop enhancement available; reduced motion removes reveal transition; forced colors adds CanvasText border and removes preview shadow.
archive.dialog: min(1080px,calc(100% - 64px)); max-height calc(100dvh - 64px); padding 48px; internal scrolling/overscroll containment; mobile inset 32px/padding 24px.
archive.sharedNote: Original image, context, role, design focus, contribution and full case-study link; modal h2/static h1.

fullNavigation.semantics: Skip link; named Primary, Footer and Professional profiles navigation; six genuine section anchors.
fullNavigation.compact: 1000px Menu synchronization; Escape restores summary focus; navigation closes Menu and focuses destination.
fullNavigation.fallback: Native details starts open and stays in flow without JavaScript; approved separate theme button.

assets.provenance: Original user portfolio repository bb92411; no generated project imagery

verification.scope: Historical locked Phase 1 Hero/theme evidence only; not complete-homepage verification.
verification.behavior: Keyboard and touch theme switching, system changes, refresh persistence, storage denial, no-JavaScript fallback, global Escape focus return, 200% text resizing, 320px reflow and forced-colors focus
verification.preservation: HaierMall article/data bytes and all project/metrics CSS rules match 05968af; headline, description and CTA copy unchanged
